capabilities: Transcribe images into Markdown using AI models
Create a new note for each processed image and attach the image
Queue and process multiple dropped images sequentially
Configure API providers, models, and transcription prompts
Control note naming, output folders, and processed-image history
extras: A managed transcription beta ($6 USD/month for up to 200 images) is proposed but not yet built; signing up via a Google Form creates no subscription. Bring-your-own-key and GitHub Copilot modes are free. README documents that images are sent to the chosen AI provider and that the plugin has no analytics or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert photos of handwritten or printed text into editable Markdown notes.

requires.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, or OpenAI-compatible endpoint API key
GitHub Copilot account (login flow instead of an API key)

summary: AI transcription plugin that turns photos of handwritten or printed notes into new Markdown notes with the image attached.
